Issue #180 public lineage preparation is complete and remains explicitly unreviewed.

Implemented `benchmark/scripts/lineage.py` with deterministic generation and `--check`; it preflights pinned sources, coverage, development cases, prepared commits, archive members, hashes, and output safety before writing.

Generated `benchmark/lineage.json` and `benchmark/lineage.md`, and pinned all split evidence in `benchmark/preparation.json`.

Inventory result: 829 artifacts (530 originals, 299 archive members) across 2 repositories; 24 exact-duplicate groups containing 50 members, including 6 groups spanning distinct original/archive locations.

Candidate result: 230 overlapping candidate groups, 1,244 distinct unequal-hash pairs, and 13 groups with recorded save-version differences. All candidates are `candidate-unadjudicated`; hash inequality is not treated as independence.

Static XML membership yielded 647 declarations and 151 unresolved/unsupported gaps. Parent, friend, and implicit private-data entries are excluded from ownership inference. Native structural comparison was not performed.

The development map contains 11 cases under the existing `public-ni-actor-framework-all-projects-copies-variants` lineage; independent assertions confirmed exact partitioning, candidate references/statuses, and case-to-lineage membership.

`python3 -I benchmark/scripts/lineage.py --check` passed. `python3 -I policy/evaluator/evaluate.py --check` passed with indexed evidence; benchmark execution remains false and baseline/challenges remain missing. `git diff --check` passed.

## Discoveries
- Qualified-name clues are available for 120 XML library/class containers, but unresolved paths and semantic/native behavior remain gaps; see `benchmark/lineage.json`.
- Public repository envelopes remain development constraints, not independent evaluation lineages; all public history and derivatives remain exposed.

## What next
A separate reviewer should inspect the method and substantive inventory before owner acceptance. Split must remain `not-started` until a restricted store, custodian, private/new cases, native structural comparison, and executed isolation tests exist. Do not allocate evaluation partitions or claim benchmark readiness; no product code was changed.
